visual_review.observation: All final sampled frames show object remaining in original bowl with open withdrawn gripper. A carries bottle upright; B fruit drops/settles after opening. This is a sparse image review; raw trajectory and contact streams support the motion between these samples.

source_code_findings.planning_attachment: world.attachment only collision-planner geometry and cuRobo spheres; physical object is moved by gripper contacts
source_code_findings.source_predicate: objects settled, lifted, then container-footprint + upward filtered contact support + linear speed <0.003 m/s; final state re-evaluated, not only latched completion
source_code_findings.limitation: No long-duration post-episode stability test; finite recorded endpoint window only. Body contacts are recorded at control rate; collision geometry physics audits are separate.
source_code_findings.setter_scope_note: Inspected the current collector/environment/planner paths, not a full transitive binary audit. FCL set_obstacle_pose updates CPU planning-world observations, not simulation state.

summary.claim_scope: Stored fixed-seed single episodes support physical task completion. No new physics rerun or new long-horizon stability validation performed.
